{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00 with recent declines), as models tend to overestimate prices in bullish periods.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if the last 3-5 days show a sharp price drop (e.g., >10% decline) and sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is >15% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 10-20% unless sentiment is strongly bullish.",
    "Avoid over-optimism after spikes: if price spiked >10% in last 3 days, cap forecast increase to 5% max for next 3 days.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment: if sentiment >0.5, allow 10-15% upward adjustment, but only if recent price action supports it.",
    "For long-term (30d) forecasts, apply a 3-5% downward bias if sentiment is neutral or negative over last 5 days.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., >10% underperformance for 3+ consecutive days), reduce forecast by 5-10% for next period unless sentiment is strong."
  ]
}
